Question: How many orders does each department have in the PostgreSQL testbed?","metadata":{"structural":{"sources":[{"source":"PostgreSQL testbed","connector_type":"postgres","executed_query":"SELECT r.\"department_name\"::text AS group_value,r.\"department_id\"::text AS group_key,count(l.\"department_id\")::text AS value,count(l.\"department_id\") AS cell_size FROM \"public\".\"departments\" r LEFT JOIN \"public\".\"orders\" l ON l.\"department_id\"=r.\"department_id\" GROUP BY r.\"department_name\",r.\"department_id\" ORDER BY (count(l.\"department_id\")::text)::numeric DESC,r.\"department_id\" ASC LIMIT 100","filters":[]}]},"statistical":{"source_1_aggregate_count":12,"source_1_aggregate_1":388,"source_1_aggregate_2":301,"source_1_aggregate_3":197,"source_1_aggregate_4":152,"source_1_aggregate_5":121,"source_1_aggregate_6":88,"source_1_aggregate_7":64,"source_1_aggregate_8":52,"source_1_aggregate_9":41,"source_1_aggregate_10":41,"source_1_aggregate_11":30,"source_1_aggregate_12":25,"source_1_group_count":12,"source_1_highest":388,"source_1_lowest":25,"source_1_spread":363,"source_1_tie_1_value":41,"source_1_tie_1_group_count":2}},"identifier_fingerprints":[]}

response.content: Across 12 departments in the PostgreSQL testbed, the highest order count was 388 and the lowest was 25, a spread of 363 orders; two departments tied at 41 orders each.
